annotations.title: A subject's history on the record

description: One subject's change history and current state from oddly's record, with both clocks on every row: observed_at (when the source says it was true) and fetched_at (when oddly looked), and the receipt hash of each row so any value can be checked with record_verify_receipt. Rate: meter data.history, US$0, attribution required (cite oddly and the subject). Returns an honest empty answer for a subject the record has never observed, which is never metered.

subject_key.description: The subject key exactly as the record prints it on /record/subject?key=..., e.g. 'benchmark-cell:commerce/baby/clothing|SG|*|local|*|*'.
